name: psp-payments
description: Integrate a merchant application with the PSP payment API (deposits, withdrawals, refunds, captures/voids, card tokens, recurring/subscriptions, hosted fields, Apple Pay / Google Pay), implement webhook handling and safe payment-state to order-state mapping, and verify the flow against the PSP sandbox.
